title: Course Review
description: The closing wrap-up of Python: two cumulative review pages that retrieve and apply every module in new scenarios, followed by the course's graded multiple-choice final listed in course.json assessments.
sourceCoverageNotes: Learner-facing label: every course ends with a module titled exactly 'Course Review'; this module is the Python instance, with the course-scoped id python-course-review.

Inventory of mixed teaching/review modules: fastapi-services ends with the existing review topic python-review (S19 row 0, kind review), which is Standard-only retrieval; Fast learners have no review row. It is not moved, regrouped or re-pathed, and these pages use new scenarios instead of repeating its mutable-default, caught-exception and stage-locating tasks.

Both topics here are new Course Review assets, not syllabus rows: each maps no curriculum pointer and adds nothing to the canonical topic count. python-review-language-and-scripts reviews python-fundamentals; python-review-pipeline-and-service reviews data-pipelines and fastapi-services along the Fast route, so its prerequisites omit the Standard-only connecting-to-postgres-from-python-with-psycopg topic. Every concept they use is taught earlier and listed in their topic.json prerequisites.

Order at the course end: the three taught modules, then this Course Review module (its two pages in order), then the distinct course-level graded multiple-choice final listed in course.json assessments. Course Review pages are ungraded practice and carry no GIFT.

Workbook placement: the Fast rows 'Course Review: cumulative review and scenario page 1' and 'page 2' map to python-review-language-and-scripts and python-review-pipeline-and-service in that order. No course time fit or calendar change is claimed here.
